notes.title: MotoGP™19: New patch available
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34981005/9468bd7abcad83a7213161c641cabd6dea3b162c.jpg[/img]

A new patch is now available! Following your feedback we have built a new patch in order to improve: the physics of the MotoGP bikes, as requested by many of you; the AI in Brno and Valencia circuits. We also added the leaderboard button in the eSport Section.
New updates will come in the future thanks to your help, continue to give us your suggestion!

tags.feature: - We also added the leaderboard button in the eSport Section.
